name: msolve
localPortabilityPatches: Do not include POSIX getopt.h from the library-only Windows build.
Define ssize_t and SSIZE_MAX for the bundled getdelim implementation under the native Windows SDK.
Redirect upstream process exits through the Sage.js native/Wasm containment boundary.
Namespace msolve's private prime helpers to avoid whole-addon symbol collisions.
Make the scalar row-conversion degree-fall check defined for empty matrices and independent of OpenMP loop scheduling.
Release modular Groebner metadata through its complete upstream destructor instead of leaking pair, hash, and conversion workspaces.
scope: Packed F4 over prime fields and modular Groebner bases over QQ; no CLI, root solver, or public msolve ABI is exposed.
